d:
Sannata lekar aaya hai Paris Catacombs ki ek aisi khaufnaak kahani, jahan zameen ke neeche 60 lakh insaani kankal dafan hain. Kabhi laakhon laashon ko chhupane ke liye banayi gayi in surangon mein aaj bhi kai raaste anjaane hain. Ek aadmi jo andhere mein kho gaya aur kabhi laut nahi paaya, kuch log jo teen din tak in surangon mein phanse rahe, aur 2004 mein mila ek aisa secret cinema jo agle hi din gayab ho gaya. Aakhir in 300 kilometer lambi surangon mein kaun se raaz aaj bhi chhupe hain?
Dekhiye Sannata
